an3.51:2.1: As always, when others make a sincere confession, the Buddha does not try to placate them or dimiss what they say. Rather, he first acknowledges it, then moves to redress it.
an3.51:2.4: BB has “support” for parayana. It does indeed mean that at AN 3.36, etc. But here it must be a synonym of the other terms.
an3.51:3.1: This verse is found at [sn1.3:3.1]() and [sn2.19:2.1](). In both cases it is the verse spoken, not by the Buddha as here, but by a deity, and then trumped by the Buddha, who takes it to a higher plane.
